question: Can a local mutually-repelling system remain size-bounded when the surroundings are a reactive distribution with an initial rarefied cavity and the far contribution is an explicit inverse-square field of a spherically replaced distant complex, without a separate attractive term?

rejected.A_larger_open_volume: Same exploding shell as v1 P1
rejected.B_periodic_images: Net-charge sum needs neutralizing background or induced opposite sources
rejected.D_lattice_flux_field: Instantaneous Gauss law is the same Coulomb pair; finite propagation is a later version

finite_N_choice.reason: Uniform infinite medium and a concentric spherical far complex exert no net force in the cavity (P0, shell theorem) and cannot hold by themselves; v2 therefore tests a specified rarefaction plus reaction of a near layer, with a holonomic radial belt standing in for nested outer equilibrium of that layer only

equation: mu_i*x_i'' = sum_{a!=i} kappa*N_i*N_a*(x_i-x_a)/abs(x_i-x_a)^3 + F_i_infinity; nabla^2 Phi = -4*pi*kappa*rho outside the far replacement; Phi_infinity = kappa*N_infinity/R_infinity and F_infinity = 0 for r < R_infinity
additional_assumptions: Eight effective nodes with no internal nested equilibria
Pairwise central repulsion with linear vector superposition; no direct attractive term
Common unit susceptibility; N_i=mu_i in normalized units
Inertia, instantaneous quasistatic pair interactions, no wave delay
Far complex replaced by a sphere: Phi_infinity constant, F_infinity = 0 inside; this is a limit rule, not a pair-force cutoff
Near surroundings are a reactive spherical belt with an initial cavity
Radial holonomic walls on reservoir nodes only replace nested outer holding of the belt, not attraction among the octet

T0a.geometry: Uniform thin spherical shell, same as v1 P0
T0a.expectation: Zero net force inside; inverse-square outside

T0b.geometry: Concentric thick shell R_in=3 ell, R_out=4 ell, spherically symmetric uniform volume density
T0b.expectation: Zero net force in the cavity

T0c.geometry: Same thick shell plus probe displaced by 0.2 ell
T0c.expectation: No restoring well and no central spring from a uniform shell

T0d.N_infinity_rule: Campaign N_infinity is the count of cubic lattice points of spacing ell with 4 < r <= 20, no jitter, index range covering that ball; that total is placed on the replacement sphere of radius R_infinity (series-4 geometric replacement), not integrated as a filled ball. T0d uses probe_N_infinity=1.
T0d.expectation: F = kappa N N_infinity / r^2; log|F| + 2 log r = log|K|
